summary.name: AllInOneIME
summary.one_liner: A free macOS input method that adds AI @commands such as @improve, @translate and @question to any text field, with built-in pinyin, Korean and Hindi input.
keywords: translate text in any app mac
use_cases: Rewrite or polish a sentence in place before sending an email or chat message
Translate a line into several languages while writing
Ask an AI question without leaving the current app
Type Chinese with pinyin, Korean or Hindi input in any Mac app
Hand a task to a coding agent or AI chat from a text field
Create notes or reminders by typing an @ command
summary.what_it_does: AllInOneIME is a macOS input method that runs @ commands in any text field. @improve offers several rewritten versions of a sentence in chosen styles, and @translate writes the line in each language you add. @question inserts or copies an AI answer and can continue as a short conversation of up to five rounds. Other commands cover opening files and web addresses, saving notes, adding reminders, running Python or JavaScript, and sending iMessages. It also has built-in input for Chinese pinyin (based on Rime), Korean Hangul and Hindi, and optional redaction of emails, numbers and keys before text reaches an AI provider.
notable: @ commands work in any text field, with results replaced in place
Optional redaction of sensitive values before a request goes to AI
Apple Intelligence on macOS 26 can answer with no key and nothing leaving the Mac
Custom scripts and Raycast Script Commands can become @ commands
caveats: AI features need your own provider key unless using Apple Intelligence on macOS 26
Chinese, Korean and Hindi are language packs downloaded when added
